item.title: Mach Five Magnet and Google Ads
item.description:
See ad spend lined up next to the leads it generated, so you know which campaigns are actually working.

Set Up

Open the app and go to Settings, then Integrations, then Google Ads. Then:

  1. Click Connect and sign in with a Google account that has access to your Ads accounts.
  2. Choose which ad accounts should feed reporting.
  3. Metrics refresh automatically once a day. Click Sync now any time for an immediate pull.

What Syncs

Spend, clicks, and conversions show next to the leads they produced. Captured and qualified leads are sent back to Google Ads as conversions, so bidding optimizes toward real leads.

item.title: Mach Five Magnet and Google Analytics
item.description:
See how visitors reach your site and behave once they get there. Sessions, pageviews, and engagement, right alongside the leads your magnets capture.

Set Up

Open the app and go to Settings, then Integrations, then Google Analytics. Then:

  1. Click Connect and sign in with a Google account that has access to your GA4 property.
  2. Choose which GA4 properties should feed reporting.
  3. See traffic beside your magnet leads under Analytics, then Traffic.
  4. Metrics refresh automatically once a day. Click Sync now any time for an immediate pull.

What Syncs

Traffic and engagement from your GA4 property show next to your magnet leads.

item.title: Mach Five Magnet and Calendly
item.description:
Let visitors book directly from a magnet conversation, and get notified the moment they do.

Set Up

Open the app and go to Settings, then Integrations, then Calendly. Then:

  1. Click Connect and authorize your Calendly account.
  2. Turn on Calendly booking for any magnet’s Book action, under Magnets.
  3. Confirmed and canceled bookings sync back to the lead automatically. Webhooks need a paid Calendly plan; a free plan still lets visitors book, just without the automatic lead sync.

What Syncs

Visitors book your Calendly events from the magnet Book button. Confirmed, rescheduled, and canceled bookings update the lead.

item.title: Mach Five Magnet and HubSpot
item.description:
Every captured lead becomes a HubSpot contact automatically, with the magnet conversation on its timeline.

Set Up

Open the app and go to Settings, then Integrations, then HubSpot. Then:

  1. Click Connect and sign in to the HubSpot account this workspace should sync into.
  2. New leads sync as contacts within minutes. Existing contacts are updated, never duplicated.
  3. Optional: turn on qualified-lead sync to set the contact lifecycle stage when you qualify a lead.

What Syncs

Each captured lead becomes a HubSpot contact, with the conversation saved as a note. Qualified leads update the lifecycle stage.

item.title: Mach Five Magnet and Salesforce
item.description:
Every captured lead becomes a Salesforce lead automatically, with the magnet conversation as a note on the record.

Set Up

Open the app and go to Settings, then Integrations, then Salesforce. Then:

  1. Click Connect and sign in to the Salesforce org this workspace should sync into.
  2. New leads sync within minutes. Existing Salesforce leads are updated by email, never duplicated.
  3. Qualified-lead sync sets the Salesforce lead status. If your org uses custom status values, set yours on this page.

What Syncs

Each captured lead becomes a Salesforce lead, with the conversation saved as a note. Qualified leads update the Salesforce lead status.

item.title: Mach Five Magnet and Zoho CRM
item.description:
Every captured lead lands in the Zoho CRM Leads module automatically, with the magnet conversation as a note.

Set Up

Open the app and go to Settings, then Integrations, then Zoho CRM. Then:

  1. Click Connect and sign in to the Zoho account this workspace should sync into.
  2. New leads sync within minutes. Existing Zoho leads are updated by email, never duplicated.
  3. Optional: turn on qualified-lead sync to set the Zoho lead status when you qualify a lead.

What Syncs

Each captured lead becomes a Zoho CRM lead, with the conversation saved as a note. Qualified leads update the Zoho lead status.

item.title: Mach Five Magnet and Microsoft Bookings
item.description:
Visitors pick a real open time and book inside the magnet, straight onto your Microsoft Bookings calendar. Each booking is added to the lead, with the Teams meeting link included.

A visitor picks a real open time inside the magnet.

Set Up

Open the app and go to Settings, then Integrations, then Microsoft Bookings. Then:

  1. Click Connect and sign in with your Microsoft 365 work account.
  2. Approve in-magnet booking on the Microsoft screen that follows. One-time, one click for a Microsoft 365 admin. It lets visitors book inside the magnet instead of on your Microsoft page.
  3. Set any magnet Book button to a Bookings page, under Magnets.
  4. Bookings sync to your leads every few minutes. Click Sync now for an immediate sync.

The integration page walks the setup, step by step.

item.title: Mach Five Magnet and HighLevel
item.description:
Every captured lead becomes a HighLevel contact automatically, with the conversation as a note and a tag your workflows can use.

Set Up

Open the app and go to Settings, then Integrations, then HighLevel. Then:

  1. In HighLevel, open the sub-account, go to Settings, then Private Integrations, and create a token with the contacts.write scope.
  2. Copy the sub-account Location ID from Settings, then Business Profile.
  3. Paste both here. Qualified leads get a tag your automations can trigger on.

What Syncs

Each captured lead becomes a HighLevel contact, with the conversation saved as a note. Qualified leads get a tag your automations can use.

item.title: Mach Five Magnet and Cal.com
item.description:
Visitors book your Cal.com events from a magnet. Each booking is added to the lead. Works on every Cal.com plan, including free.

Set Up

Open the app and go to Settings, then Integrations, then Cal.com. Then:

  1. In Cal.com, go to Settings, then Developer, then API keys, and create a key.
  2. Paste the key here. Booking sync is set up automatically.
  3. Turn on Cal.com booking for any magnet, in the Book call-to-action under Magnets.

What Syncs

Visitors book your Cal.com events from the magnet Book button. Works on every Cal.com plan, including free.

item.title: Mach Five Magnet and CallRail
item.description:
Every tracked phone call becomes a lead automatically, complete with recording and source.

Set Up

Open the app and go to Settings, then Integrations, then CallRail. Then:

  1. In CallRail, go to Integrations, then Data access, then API keys, and create a key. Read-only works for calls; Allow Writes lets us set up call sync automatically.
  2. Paste the key here and pick the account and company this workspace tracks.
  3. Calls start landing in your Leads inbox within minutes.

What Syncs

Tracked calls appear in your leads inbox with the caller, source, and recording. Calls that match an ad click are sent to Google Ads as conversions.

item.title: Mach Five Magnet and Slack
item.description:
Post every new lead to a Slack channel the moment it is captured.

Set Up

Open the app and go to Settings, then Notifications. Then:

  1. In Slack, create an app for your workspace and turn on Incoming Webhooks.
  2. Add a webhook to the channel that should receive leads and copy its URL.
  3. In the app, go to Settings, then Notifications, paste the URL under Slack, and save.
  4. Click Send test. Leads arrive as a formatted card with name, contact, and source.

What Syncs

Every new lead posts to a Slack channel the moment it is captured.

item.title: Mach Five Magnet and Microsoft Teams
item.description:
Post every new lead to a Teams channel the moment it is captured.

Set Up

Open the app and go to Settings, then Notifications. Then:

  1. In the Teams channel, open Workflows and add “Post to a channel when a webhook request is received”.
  2. Copy the workflow URL it gives you.
  3. In the app, go to Settings, then Notifications, paste the URL under Microsoft Teams, and save.
  4. Click Send test. Leads arrive as a card with name, contact, and source.

What Syncs

Every new lead posts to a Teams channel the moment it is captured.

item.title: Mach Five Magnet and Webhook
item.description:
Send every captured and qualified lead to your own endpoint as signed JSON.

Set Up

Open the app and go to Settings, then Notifications. Then:

  1. In the app, go to Settings, then Notifications.
  2. Add your endpoint URL and an optional signing secret, then save.
  3. Click Send test to confirm delivery. Leads arrive as JSON with an HMAC signature header.

What Syncs

Every captured and qualified lead is sent to your own endpoint as signed JSON.

item.title: Mach Five Magnet and Zapier
item.description:
Connect a Zapier zap to the Magnet webhook and send leads to thousands of apps.

Set Up

Open the app and go to Settings, then Notifications. Then:

  1. In Zapier, create a zap with the Webhooks by Zapier trigger and choose Catch Hook.
  2. Copy the hook URL into the app under Settings, then Notifications, then save.
  3. Click Send test, then map the lead fields in your zap.

What Syncs

Connect a Zapier zap to the Magnet webhook and send leads to thousands of apps.
